sourceRef.section: PRIEST SPELLS, General Priest Spells, Cleric Spells, Druid Spells, Oracle Spells

description: Priest spells draw upon divine, spiritual, natural, or prophetic powers. They may represent prayers, miracles, spiritual manifestations, or supernatural techniques depending on the character's beliefs and traditions.

spells.name: Judgment Bolt
spells.effect: A straightforward offensive miracle, providing a more attack-focused alternative to Radiant Bolt.

spells.name: Guiding Ray
spells.effect: On a Surge, the next friendly Attack against the target during this Round gains +1 Attack die.

spells.name: Sun Lance
spells.effect: A powerful concentrated beam of divine energy, dealing substantial Damage at extended Range. It follows normal Heavy restrictions.

clericSpells.description: Cleric spells emphasize divine punishment, protection against supernatural threats, and holy energy.

spells.name: Hallowed Sweep
spells.effect: A wave of divine energy strikes the target and nearby Units. Resolve Blast 1" normally.

spells.name: Banishing Light
spells.effect: A specialized Attack designed to combat demons and other Units possessing the Demon category. Anti-Demon 2 grants two additional Attack dice against eligible targets.

druidSpells.description: Druid spells manipulate natural forces, vegetation, and the surrounding environment.

spells.name: Briarstorm
spells.effect: The caster summons a violent burst of thorns, roots, and vines around the target. Resolve Blast 1" normally.

spells.name: Vine Snare
spells.effect: If the Attack deals Damage, the target suffers Slow 2 until the end of its next Movement activation.

oracleSpells.description: Oracle spells manipulate fate, perception, and the immediate outcomes of battle.

spells.name: Fate Needle
spells.effect: A precise supernatural strike guided toward an anticipated weakness. Pinpoint ignores the usual penalty for firing into an Engagement.

spells.name: Doom Mark
spells.effect: If the Attack deals Damage, the target worsens Hit by 1 step during its next Attack, provided that Attack occurs before the end of the Round.

designNotes: v4 balance pass (post-playtesting): Damage-1 spells gained +1 Attack; the Damage-2/Heavy Sun Lance kept its listed Attacks and gained Anti-Undead 1, matching the equivalent policy applied to PC equipment and Generic Units.
v5 balance pass (second damage-output pass): Damage-1 spells gained a further +1 Attack; Sun Lance raised its Anti-Undead to 2.
